# License Atlas reference component

Presentation and workflow tree are taken directly from the HTML uploaded by the user.
Original SHA-256: `70c8ad24023626277581998554e21cf8b48e8d478977979fc2686ab31f8a58e3`.

The original CSS cascade, tree functions, animations, translations, cover renderer and Process Studio remain intact. The seed is removed: authorized Buyer Log data arrives through a sandboxed message bridge. integration.js replaces local-only persistence and unsafe supplier projection. integration.css adds commerce summaries without changing tree layout.

This component deliberately preserves the user-requested Atlas visual language in its own sandbox; Buyer Log's global design tokens are unchanged. The reference includes its own TR/EN dictionary and reduced-motion handling.
